note: Ohio U.S. Senate special and governor races, researched Oct. 24, 2026.

candidates.name: Sherrod Brown
candidates.bio: U.S. senator from Ohio from 2007 to 2025; earlier a U.S. representative and Ohio secretary of state.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown supports abortion access and voted against abortion restrictions in 2022
source.quote: abortion access for all women

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown voted against a 20-week abortion ban (Senate roll call 25, 2018)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown voted for $369 billion in clean energy tax credits (Inflation Reduction Act, Senate roll call 325, 2022)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown supports action on climate change but opposed the EPA’s 2024 limits on coal plant emissions
source.quote: an unrealistic, unachievable rule

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown voted to keep limits on air pollution from new heavy-duty vehicles (Senate roll call 98, 2023)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown voted for the infrastructure law (Senate roll call 314, 2021)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown said vouchers moved money out of public education into private schools (Ohio Capital Journal, 2022)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown on public school funding
source.quote: make sure our public schools have the resources they need

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown wants to strengthen the border and give border agents more resources
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown supported a path to citizenship for DACA recipients (2017)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown on police funding
source.quote: the resources, training, and support they need

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown voted to let Medicare negotiate drug prices (Senate roll call 325, 2022) and sponsored a $35 monthly insulin cap
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown supports the Affordable Care Act (Ohio Capital Journal, 2024)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown sponsored a bill to expand organizing and collective bargaining rights (S. 420)

guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown sponsored a bill banning discrimination based on sex, sexual orientation and gender identity (S. 393)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown supports raising the minimum wage to $17 an hour
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Brown voted to raise taxes on corporations and the wealthy (Senate roll call 357, 2021) and opposes tax cuts for the richest

candidates.name: Jon Husted
candidates.bio: Appointed to the U.S. Senate in January 2025 to fill J.D. Vance’s seat; previously Ohio lieutenant governor and secretary of state.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted cosponsored S. 186 to bar federal funding of abortion and opposed Ohio’s 2023 abortion-rights amendment
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted supported overturning Roe v. Wade and cosponsored S. 186
source.quote: defending the rights of women, children, and the unborn

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted to end Biden-era clean energy tax credits (H.R. 1, Senate roll call 372, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted supports repealing EPA greenhouse gas standards for coal plants
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted to undo rules on emissions of seven hazardous air pollutants (Senate roll call 229, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted supports funding law enforcement
source.quote: more tools to convict criminals

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted to increase defense spending (H.R. 1, Senate roll call 372, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted to cut existing USAID foreign aid and public broadcasting funds (Senate roll call 411, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted helped create Ohio’s EdChoice scholarship
source.quote: empowers parents

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted for the 2025 law that cut Medicaid (H.R. 1, Senate roll call 372)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted on the border
source.quote: securing the border and adding more agents

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted to increase ICE funding by $75 billion (H.R. 1, Senate roll call 372, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted supported Ohio’s HB 68, banning gender-affirming care for minors
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted backed Ohio’s parents’ bill of rights (HB 8) and says men should not compete in women’s sports
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted against raising the federal minimum wage to $17 by 2030 (Senate roll call 184, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted sponsored a bill to repeal the federal estate tax and voted to extend the 2017 tax cuts
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted proposed a photo ID requirement for federal elections
source.quote: Passing voter ID requirements is common sense

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted voted twice in 2026 against requiring congressional authorization for military action in Iran (S.J.Res. 123)
guides.vote, 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate voters guide: Husted backed the president’s military action against Iran, calling it decisive

notes.text: A special election: the winner serves the rest of J.D. Vance’s term, through January 2029.
